title: Synchronize task state through custom remote refs
description: User removed browser-only agent requirement. Keep local and GitHub task state at refs/agent-tasks/state; no ordinary task branch. Assess API Git database access and migrate only after live verification.
acceptance: Explicit sync publishes and adopts custom ref while ordinary clone/fetch and branch lists contain no task branch.
Known remote observations are scoped to the ref; legacy branch records cannot cause false deletion errors.
Remote tips must be commits; existing merge/conflict/non-fast-forward and source-isolation tests still pass.
GitHub refs/commits/trees/blobs API reads canonical task JSON; validated migration preserves project and tasks before deleting legacy branch.
